beat.headline: QUALITY & COMPARABILITY

sources: As such, data quality, reliability and comparability pose significant challenges.
prompt:
TESSERA STYLE SHEET
1. Modern editorial paper collage. Bold magazine composition, refined 2D motion design.
2. One dominant flat block-colour background for the whole shot: soft violet. Never a rainbow, never a gradient.
3. Subjects are black-and-white halftone photographic cutouts with rough white torn-paper edges: objects, machines, buildings, maps, coins, screens, vehicles, anonymous paper hands. Never a recognisable person's face.
4. Diagram elements are flat matte paper shapes and ribbons in cream, black, pale yellow, or the background's contrasting colour. Real paper texture, print dots, small tape pieces.
5. Consistent upper-left light. Small paper-layer shadows only.
6. Everything is flat matte printed paper. No glow, no neon, no bloom, no halos, no luminous edges. Nothing emits light. Not glossy 3D. Not live action.
7. Headline typography: one extra-bold sans-serif, black or cream, printed on paper chips, large, safe margins. English spelling and letterforms accurate and stable. Only the headline text in the copy list, nothing else.
8. Motion: elements enter fast with slight overshoot and a stable landing, then hold a clear reading window. One strongest visual focus at a time. No camera shake. Movement starts on the first frame; a small loop continues at the end. No empty frames.
9. Numbers, when specified, are printed complete from their first visible frame. Never counting up, never morphing, never redrawn.
10. No brands, logos, watermarks, or text beyond the copy list.
11. 16:9, exactly 5 seconds, one composition, at most one crisp cut.
12. Identity anchor: rough white torn-paper edges on every cutout; small paper shadow from upper-left light.

BEAT
Ground: soft violet.
Subjects: the scattered pieces; a paper ribbon.
Opens on the scattered pieces, carried over from the previous shot, which transforms as the action begins.
Action: A paper ribbon threads through the scattered pieces and tries to bind them into one strip.
Ends holding on the ribbon strip.
Headline printed on a paper chip: "QUALITY & COMPARABILITY".

COPY LIST: "QUALITY & COMPARABILITY". Exact strings; nothing else appears in frame.

AUDIO: One English narrator, warm, clear, natural, brisk but unhurried, never an advertising shout. Speak the following line exactly once, word for word, beginning on the first frame: "So quality, reliability and comparability of data are significant challenges.". No other dialogue. Light paper-slap and tape sound effects beneath the voice; no music.
expandedPrompt:
For the target video, at 0.00 seconds into the target video, <Picture 1> (from [Shot 1]) is fully referenced.

integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] This is a 2D-animated, modern editorial paper collage. The scene opens on <Picture 1>, featuring a flat, matte, soft violet background. The composition consists of black-and-white halftone photographic cutouts with rough white torn-paper edges, including a fragmented world map, all casting small, subtle shadows from a consistent light source in the upper-left. On the first frame, a cream-colored paper chip with a rough torn edge is centered, displaying the headline "FRAGMENTED STANDARDS" in an extra-bold black sans-serif typeface. As the action begins, the "FRAGMENTED STANDARDS" chip and the world map pieces swiftly slide apart and scatter across the violet ground with a fast motion and a slight overshoot. Simultaneously, a flat matte cream paper ribbon enters the frame from the left, threading fluidly through the scattered black-and-white paper fragments. The ribbon winds around the pieces, binding them together into a single, organized horizontal strip. As the fragments are bound, the original headline chip is replaced by a new cream paper chip that slides in rapidly and lands stably, displaying the text "QUALITY & COMPARABILITY" in clean, legible, extra-bold black sans-serif letters. A male narrator (S1), with a warm, clear, and natural timbre and a brisk but unhurried speaking rate, says <d>[English] So quality, reliability and comparability of data are significant challenges.</d> The camera remains in a Static Shot throughout the 5 seconds. By the end of the shot, the composition holds on the bound ribbon strip and the final headline, with a very subtle, slow looping pulse of the paper elements to maintain visual energy.

overall_soundscape: The audio is dominated by the narrator's voice. Beneath the speech, there are tactile, diegetic sound effects: the crisp, rhythmic slap of heavy paper hitting a surface and the short, sticky peeling and pressing sounds of adhesive tape being applied.
